annotation: The participant parted their lips slightly, tilted their head to the right, lifted their right foot, balancing on their left, with their hands clasped behind their back.
The participant smiled with squinted eyes, tilting their head to the right with their hands clasped behind their back.
The participant smiled, tilted their head to the right and slightly back, looked upwards, and held their hands behind their back.
The participant bent forward, their left hand touched their knee, their head tilted to the right, eyes looking down.
